existingAuthorityRules.rule: OpenAPI declares server base /api/v1 and operation paths such as /auth/login without duplicating the server base.
Canonical OpenAPI uses /api/v1 as a server base; RC paths intentionally omit it.
When OpenAPI server URL ends in /v1, raw OpenAPI paths beginning with / are canonicalized by prepending /v1; the generated alignment inventory records both canonical /v1 path and raw openapiPath.
serverPrefix is /api/v1 and canonical inventory paths are represented as /v1/... with openapiPath retaining the unprefixed OpenAPI path.

representations.role: transport server base plus operation-relative path
OpenAPI-relative operation representation used by the policy layer

reconciliationRule: The /v1 prefix is transport/public API versioning in the API Inventory representation; the OpenAPI and Auth Policy path strings omit the declared server base and therefore MUST NOT be interpreted as alternate public canonical routes.
disposition: B01-CONFLICT-003 can be marked RESOLVED at representation/reconciliation level without changing the OpenAPI path strings, API operation IDs, API inventory, or operation policy.
